description.en:
Opens a "stand" talk scene, where the detailed character models stand in front of a blurred background.
It saves the camera's DepthLevel, fades it to EV_TALK_DP_LVL (10.0) and the depth range from 1.0 to 1.5 over _frame frames, and adds the depth-of-field blur (CMND_BOKE_CREATE(0.9, 7.0)). After waiting _frame frames it pauses the field characters, map and camera (pause bits OFF_RPG_CHARA, OFF_RPG_MAP and OFF_RPG_CAMERA, keeping the previous bits to restore). EndStandEvent undoes all of this.
Calling it while a stand scene is already open only prints a debug message.
Length of the transition in frames.
